name: ope-web
description: El frontend de OPE: la consola de operación y, después, el portal del merchant, sobre un núcleo compartido.

scripts.build: npm run build:paquetes && tsc -p tsconfig.json && npm run build --workspaces --if-present
scripts.dev: npm run build:paquetes && npm run dev -w apps/console
scripts.test: npm run build:paquetes && ope-check && node tests/roles.mjs --verificar && node tests/constraints.mjs --verificar && node tests/icons.mjs && npm --prefix packages/session test && vitest run
scripts.tipos: npx -y openapi-typescript apps/console/contracts/demo.yaml -o apps/console/src/api/demo/types.ts && node tests/roles.mjs && node tests/constraints.mjs
